summary: Expose declared/live model drift and safely return transient fallback seats at idle boundaries

replay.detail: Model fallback observations and bridge restart admissions are retained as internal claims. Reconciliation uses durable incarnation, episode and declaration fences; replaying an observation or admission does not create another restart.

schema.detail: Adds internal model-return claims and optional declaration/config policy fields. Shared agent cards add optional declared_model and model_drift fields under freeze exemption E3. Adds no SQLite indexes or online index backfills: attempt lookups seek the existing claims subject/kind index with JSON residuals; roster invalidation uses the existing timeline frontier index, current-slot primary-key ranges and observation rowid lookups.

rules.detail: The interim model-return bridge defaults on. Only positively classified transient drift older than ten minutes can request the supported idle-gated restart action; quota, auth, unknown, stale, busy, exhausted hourly budgets and occupied host admission never authorize a bridge restart.

compatibility.detail: Existing card decoders continue accepting cards with or without the additive model metadata. Missing model evidence is unknown rather than healthy. Same-model held usage refreshes invalidate cached model-drift evidence even without a new replicated claim; response/subagent spend does not. Legacy harnesses without fallback cause evidence cannot authorize a restart.

downtime.detail: An admitted transient return replaces the idle seat process through the existing restart lifecycle and resumes its conversation. No forced timeout restart or provider probe is added.

manual.detail: Policy supports fleet, persona and agent overrides. Disable the interim bridge after pinning an OMP release with native next-turn fallback return. No live configuration changes or restarts are part of this source change.

recovery.detail: Disable bridge policy to stop new automatic return admissions; drift observation remains available. Preserve internal claim history so hourly budgets and admission receipts survive daemon replacement.
